sources.title: London Logistics Plan 2026: progress update
sources.verified_claim: The 2026 progress update sets draft objectives for productivity, inclusion, green growth and global competitiveness and says the final Logistics Plan is due at the end of 2026. Draft objectives and baseline evidence are not parcel logistics capacity.

sources.title: London Growth Plan
sources.verified_claim: The current Growth Plan page links the March 2026 Logistics Plan progress update and lists logistics objectives around freight networks, kerbside management, decarbonisation and land use. Strategic objectives are not exact site servicing evidence.

sources.title: Freight & servicing in London
sources.verified_claim: TfL's freight hub covers safe, clean, efficient and legal deliveries and servicing. Operational guidance does not establish whether a sample parcel has adequate loading, access or servicing capacity.

sources.title: Safe deliveries
sources.verified_claim: TfL describes Direct Vision Standard, HGV permits, FORS and construction-logistics safety initiatives. Compliance requirements are not evidence of parcel-specific freight feasibility.

sources.title: Clean deliveries and land use
sources.verified_claim: TfL promotes cleaner delivery modes, cargo bikes, electric vehicles and light freight by water. Programme availability does not prove a sample parcel can accommodate those modes.

sources.title: Efficient deliveries for business
sources.verified_claim: TfL provides toolkits on consolidation, cargo bikes and retiming deliveries to reduce congestion and improve efficiency. Business guidance is not parcel delivery-and-servicing capacity evidence.

sources.title: Safeguarded Wharves Reviews
sources.verified_claim: City Hall explains the safeguarded-wharf network and its role in protecting waterborne freight handling. The network is spatially specific, but no candidate intersection is inferred without exact spatial matching.

sources.title: Future of freight plan
sources.verified_claim: The national plan sets long-term priorities for the freight network, net zero, planning, people and skills, and data and technology. Its age and national scope are retained and it is not parcel-level evidence.
